title: DeepFusion-HSK multimodal deep learning classifies herpes simplex keratitis subtypes
summary: A retrospective multicenter study used 3,501 slit-lamp images (807 eyes) for development and two external cohorts (2,957 images). DeepFusion-HSK fuses diffuse light, slit-beam and fluorescein staining images and reached internal accuracy of 85.1% (95% CI 78.5%-90.0%) with AUCs of 0.947-0.949 for epithelial versus non-epithelial herpes simplex keratitis, outperforming Swin-Transformer, EfficientNetV2 and ResNet50. External accuracy was 81.7% (Dataset I) and 78.2% (Dataset II); resilience to complete fluorescein-image dropout was also evaluated. Data are retrospective and image-level.
ai_technology: Multimodal deep learning (DeepFusion-HSK) with tri-way higher-order interaction fusion

evidence.unknown: Prospective clinical performance; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies keratitis subtype from slit-lamp images
